title: LORD, LET EVERY ARROW OF STRESS AND PRESSURE BE BROKEN
text: Before we begin, I want to encourage you to share this prayer with someone who needs to hear it today. There is somebody under unusual pressure right now. There is somebody dealing with stress that is beyond human [music] explanation and the Lord has orchestrated that this word should come to them at this hour. Don't keep this to yourself. Share it on your timeline. Send it in your family group. Let it go to that friend who has been carrying burdens that are crushing their spirit. The Lord is about to do something in the next few minutes that will shift the narrative of many lives. I want you to understand something about the kingdom of darkness and the strategies of hell. The enemy does not have many weapons, but the few he has, he uses with surgical [music] precision. And one of the most effective weapons in the arsenal of darkness is what I call the arrow of [music] stress and pressure. Now, when I say arrow, I'm not speaking metaphorically for the sake of religious language. I'm speaking about actual projectiles from the kingdom of darkness that are designed to hit specific targets in your [music] life. The Bible says in Ephesians 6:16, "Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked." [music] The word darts there in the original language refers to arrows that have been set on fire, arrows that have been dipped in poison, arrows that carry assignment. When the enemy releases an arrow of stress into your life, it is not just a natural phenomenon of life's challenges. It is a demonic strategy [music] designed to weaken your spiritual capacity to reduce your prayer life, to make you vulnerable, [music] to open you up to other forms of attack. Stress is a gateway affliction. When a man is under stress, his judgment becomes impaired. When a woman is under unusual pressure, she begins to make decisions that are not consistent with the will of God [music] for her life. I have seen men and women of God who stood strong in their faith. But when the arrow of stress hits them, they began to compromise. They began to negotiate with the enemy. They began to settle for less than what God promised them. Let me show you something in the scriptures. When you go to the book of Nehemiah chapter 4, you will see that when the enemies of Israel saw that the wall was being [music] rebuilt. They didn't just attack with physical weapons. The Bible says they mocked them, they threatened them, they created an atmosphere of fear and pressure. Nehemiah 4:10 says, "And Judah said, the strength of the bearers of burdens is decayed, and there is much rubbish so that we are not able to build a wall." Do you see what happened? The workers began to focus on the magnitude of the rubble instead of the mandate of God. That is what stress does. It [music] magnifies your problems and minimizes God's promises. It makes the obstacle look bigger than the one who called you. But I want you to notice what Nehemiah did. He didn't organize a counseling session. He didn't call for a seminar on stress management. Nehemiah 4:14 says, "And I looked and rose up and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, be not ye afraid of them. Remember the Lord, which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses." Nehemiah understood that the battle was spiritual before it was physical. He understood that fear and pressure were weapons of warfare and the antidote was not [music] therapy but remembrance of who God is. Now I need you to follow me carefully because I'm about to show you the anatomy of an arrow of [music] stress. Every arrow has three components. The tip, the shaft, and [music] the feathers. In the spiritual realm, the tip of the arrow represents the initial [music] point of contact. It could be a bad report from the doctor. It could be a financial crisis. It could be a betrayal from someone you trusted. It could be a delay in something you've been praying for. That is the tip that penetrates your soul. The shaft is the prolonged nature of the problem. It's not just that the problem came is that it refuses to leave. Is the chronicity of the situation that begins to weigh you down. And the feathers represent the direction and the accuracy with which the enemy has targeted you. But here is what you need to know. Every arrow that the enemy releases has to travel through the atmosphere before it gets to you. And in that atmosphere there are ministering angels. There are divine protocols. There are heavenly centuries that have been assigned to intercept projectiles [music] from the kingdom of darkness. The problem is that many believers do not activate their angelic assistance. Many people are living as though they are alone in this world as though they have to fight every battle by themselves. Psalm 91-11 says, "For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways." I want to prophesy to somebody right now. The arrow that was released against you 3 weeks ago, the arrow that was supposed to hit you yesterday, the arrow that the enemy has scheduled to be released against you next month, the Lord is giving his angels charge concerning you, and that arrow will not find his target. [music] I see by the spirit that there is an interception happening in the realm of the spirit. I see angelic beings taking positions around your life, around your family, around your business, around your health. And every arrow of stress and pressure is being caught [music] mid-flight and destroyed before it reaches you. Now, let me take you to the prayer of Elisha in 2 [music] Kings 6. The Bible tells us that the king of Syria was waring against Israel. And every time he set an ambush, Elisha would warn the king of Israel. The king of Syria became so [music] frustrated that he thought there was a spy in his camp. But his servants told him, Elisha, the prophet that is in Israel, tellth the king of Israel the words that thou speakest in thy bed chamber. Do you understand what this means? Elisha had a level of spiritual [music] intelligence that gave him access to classified information in the kingdom of darkness. He could hear what demons were plotting in secret [music] chambers. And I declare over your life today, the spirit of revelation is coming upon you. You will begin to discern the schemes of the enemy before they manifest. You will have dreams and visions that will show you what the enemy is planning and you will abort those plans through prophetic intercession. The Bible says in Amos 3:7, "Surely the Lord God will do nothing, but he revealth his secret unto his servants, the prophets." God is raising up a generation of prophetic intercessors who will not just react to the attacks of [music] the enemy, but will proactively dismantle those attacks before they materialize. When the king of Syria found out that Elisha was the one exposing his plans, he sent horses and chariots and a great host to surround the city where Elisha was. Early in the morning, Elisha's servant woke up and saw the enemy's army surrounding them and he panicked. He came to Elisha and said, "Alas, my master, how shall we do?" Now, this is the moment where stress and pressure could have overwhelmed Elisha. The natural circumstances were dire. They were surrounded. They were outnumbered. There was no visible way of escape. But Elisha understood something that his servant didn't understand. He understood that the natural realm is not the final reality. He understood that there is a spiritual dimension that supersedes everything that you can see with your physical eyes. And Elisha said to his servant, "Fear not, for they that be with us are more than they that be with them." And then Elisha prayed, "Lord, I pray thee, open his eyes that he may see." And the Lord opened the eyes of the young man and he saw and behold the mountain was full of horses and chariots of fire round about Elisha. This is what I want you to understand. The pressure you are feeling right now is based on incomplete information. You are looking at the situation with natural eyes and you are not seeing what God is [music] doing in the invisible realm. If God were to open your eyes right now, you would see that you are surrounded by [music] divine reinforcement. you would see that the battle has already been won in the heavens and it's only a matter of time before the manifestation catches up with the declaration. Let me [music] pray for you right now. Father, in the name of Jesus, I ask that you open the eyes of every person reading this prayer. Let them see the horses and chariots of fire that you have stationed around their lives. Let them see the angelic presence that is guarding them. Let them see that [music] the forces that are for them are greater than the forces that are against them. I decree that the spirit of fear is broken right now. I decree that the spirit of anxiety is shattered. I decree that every thought pattern that has been feeding [music] stress and pressure is being rewired by the word of God in Jesus's mighty name. Now I want to take you to another dimension of this teaching. There are arrows of stress that come from external [music] sources and there are arrows of stress that come from internal sources. External sources are the circumstances, the situations, the people, the systems that are designed to put you under pressure. But internal sources are more dangerous because they are self-generated. These are the arrows that come from negative thinking, from toxic thought patterns, from fear, from worry, from anxiety. The Bible says in Proverbs 23:7, "For as he thinkketh in his heart, so is he." Your thought life is the factory where stress is either manufactured or dismantled. Many people are under stress not because of what is happening to them, but because of what they are thinking about what is happening to them. Two people can go through the same situation and one [music] will come out victorious while the other will come out victimized. The difference is not [music] in the situation. The difference is in the interpretation of the situation. When you interpret your challenges through the lens of God's promises, you will have peace. But when you interpret your challenges through the lens of your limitations, you will have panic. I need you to understand that the mind is a battlefield. The enemy knows that if he can control your thoughts, he can control your life. That's why the Bible says in 2 Corinthians 10:4-5, "For the weapons of our warfare are not carnal, but mighty through God [music] to the pulling down of strongholds, casting down imaginations and every high thing that exaltth itself against the knowledge of God, and bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of [music] Christ." This is not just a nice scripture to quote. This is a military [music] strategy for spiritual warfare. You have to take your thoughts captive. You have to arrest every thought that does not align with what God has said about you. When a thought of fear comes, you don't entertain it. You arrest it. When a thought of failure comes, you don't meditate on it. You cast it down. When a thought of impossibility comes, you [music] don't negotiate with it. You bring it into captivity to the obedience of Christ. This is how you break the arrow of stress at the level of the mind. Because stress begins in the mind before it manifests in the body. Stress begins as a thought before it becomes a physical symptom. And if you can deal with it at the thought level, you will prevent it from progressing to the symptom level. Let me give you a practical example. You are believing God for a financial breakthrough. But every time you check your bank account, you feel stressed. The stress is not coming from the bank account. The stress is coming from the thought that your bank account will never change. You see the difference? The bank account is just information. But the interpretation of that information is what creates the emotional response. If you can change your interpretation, you can change your emotional state. Instead of looking at your bank account and saying, "I'm broke." You need to look at your bank account and say, "This is temporary. God is my source and my season of abundance is coming." I prophesy to you right now, the season of lack is over. The season of limitation is over. The season of scraping the bottom of the barrel is over. The Lord is opening up rivers in the desert and streams in the wasteland. He's preparing a table before you in the presence of your enemies. He is anointing your head with oil and your cup is running over. I decree that financial stress is broken. I decree that the pressure of debt is lifted. I decree that every collection agency that has been harassing you will be silenced. I decree that unexpected sources of income are opening up for you. I decree that what you lost in the past season, God is restoring to you sevenfold. Now, let me take you to another level. There is something called prophetic stress. And this is the kind of stress that comes when you are on the verge of a major breakthrough. The enemy knows that you are about to step into something significant. So, he increases the pressure to see if he can get you to quit before you cross the finish line. This is what happened to the children of Israel when they were coming out of Egypt. Exodus 14:10 says, "And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and behold, the Egyptians marched after them, and they were so afraid, and the children of Israel cried out unto the Lord." Notice that the greatest pressure came when they were closest to their deliverance. They had already left Egypt. They had already seen the plagues. They had already been set free. But the moment they got to the Red Sea, Pharaoh and his army came after them. And the people panicked. They said to Moses, "Because there were no graves in Egypt, has thou taken us away to die in the wilderness?" They were ready to go back to slavery [music] because the pressure of the transition was too much for them to bear. But Moses said something that you need to say to yourself right now. He said, "Fear ye not. stand still and see the salvation of [music] the Lord which he will show to you today. For the Egyptians whom ye have seen today, ye shall see them again no more forever. This is the word of the Lord for you. The pressure you are feeling right now is not a sign that you are going backward. It is a sign that you are about to break through. The stress you are experiencing is not an indication that God has abandoned you. It is an indication that the enemy is terrified of what you are about to become. Stand still. Don't panic. Don't retreat. Don't negotiate with Pharaoh. Don't go back to Egypt. Stand your ground and watch God fight for you. The Red Sea in front of you is about to part. The enemies behind you are about to drown. Your deliverance [music] is not delayed. It is divinely timed. Let me pray for you. Father, I come against every spirit of premature termination. I come against every strategy of hell that is designed to make your children quit before they break through. I decree that divine strength is being released right now. I decree that supernatural endurance is being imparted. I decree that the grace to finish what you started is being activated. I decree that every believer who has been tempted to give up is receiving a fresh wind of hope. I decree that they will not faint. They will not fall. They will not fail. They will cross over into their promised land in the mighty name of Jesus. Now, let me address those of you who are dealing with relational [music] stress. There are people in your life who are arrows of stress. They are not your enemies in the traditional sense, but their presence in your life creates chaos, confusion, and constant pressure. Some of you are in toxic relationships where you are constantly walking on eggshells, constantly trying to please someone who can never be pleased, constantly sacrificing your peace [music] for the sake of keeping the peace. And the Lord is saying to you today, it is time to set boundaries. It is time to protect your peace. It is time to realize that not everyone deserves access [music] to your life. The Bible says in Proverbs 13:20, "He that walketh with wise men shall be wise, but a companion of fools shall be destroyed. Your associations determine your altitude." You cannot swore [music] with eagles, if you are surrounded by turkeys. You cannot walk in your calling if you are tied to people who are committed to their comfort zones. I'm not telling you to be unkind or to be arrogant, but I'm telling you that you have to be strategic about who you allow to speak into your life, who you allow to influence your decisions, who you allow to occupy space in your heart. Some of the stress you are experiencing is because you are carrying people who were never meant to go with you to the next level. They were assigned to you for a season, but that season is over and you are trying to drag them into a dimension where they don't belong. And in the process, you are exhausting yourself. you are frustrating yourself and you are delaying your own progress. I decree that the grace to let go is [music] coming upon you. I decree that you will have the courage to release people who are weighing you down. I decree that you will have the wisdom to discern who is an asset and who is a liability. I decree that every toxic relationship is being exposed and dismantled by the power of the Holy Spirit. Let me take you to the story of Abraham and Lot. Genesis 13 tells us that there was strife between the herdsmen of Abraham and the herdsmen of Lot because the land was not able to bear them both. And Abraham being a man of peace said to Lot, "Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee, and between my herdsmen and thy herdsmen, for we be brethren. Is not the whole land before thee? Separate thyself, I pray thee, from me. If thou wil take the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if thou depart to the right hand, then I will go to the left. Now, Abraham was the one who brought Lot on the journey. Abraham was the one who had the promise from God. But Abraham was wise enough to know that association with Lot was creating unnecessary stress and conflict. And so, he released Lot. And the moment Abraham separated from Lot, the Bible says in Genesis 13:14, "And the Lord said unto Abraham, after that Lot was separated from him, [music] lift up now thine eyes, and look from the place where thou art northward and southward and eastward and westward. For all the land which thou seeest, to thee will I give it, and to thy seed forever." Do you see what happened? God's greater promise came after the separation. Sometimes what you are holding on to is blocking [music] what God is trying to give you. Sometimes the stress you are experiencing [music] is a sign that you need to release someone so that God can release his next level blessing into your life. I prophesy to you the moment you let go of what is draining you, God is going to open up what is ordained for you. Now let me talk to those who are dealing with the stress of delayed promises. You have been praying. You have been fasting. You have been believing God for something [music] and it seems like heaven is silent. You have been standing on the word of God. You have been confessing the promises of God. But the manifestation is not coming as fast as you expected and the delay is creating stress. You are beginning to wonder if you heard God correctly. You are beginning to question if the promise is still valid. You are beginning to doubt if you are qualified for what God said he would do. Let me take you to the story of Abraham and Sarah. God promised Abraham that he would be the father of many nations. [music] But the promise was given when Abraham was 75 years old. And it was fulfilled when Abraham was 100 years old. That's 25 years of waiting, 25 years of hoping, 25 years of believing for something that had not yet materialized. And in the process of waiting, Sarah became so stressed that she came up with her own plan. She gave her maid servant Hagar to Abraham and Ishmael was born. But Ishmael was not the promise. Ishmael was the product of pressure. Ishmael was the result of Sarah trying to help God fulfill his word. And many of you are about to bet an Ishmamail because you are too stressed to wait for Isaac. Many of you are about to settle for something good because you are too tired to wait for something God. Many of you are about to accept a counterfeit because the wait for the authentic is taking too long. And the Lord is saying to you, do not abort the promise. Do not shortcut the process. Do not let stress push you into a decision that you will regret. The delay is not a denial. The wait is not a waste. God is preparing you for what he promised you. And when Isaac finally [music] comes, you will understand why Ishmael could never be the answer. Romans 4:19:1 says, "And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about 100 years old, neither yet the deadness of Sarah's womb. He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief, but was strong in faith, giving glory to God, and being fully persuaded that what he had promised, he was able also [music] to perform. This is the secret to handling the stress of delayed promises. You have to be fully persuaded. You have to be convinced beyond any doubt that if God said it, he would do it. You have to give glory to God before the manifestation. You have to thank him for what you have not yet seen. You have to celebrate the promise while you are still in the waiting room. I decree right now that every delayed promise is coming to pass. I decree that what God said about you is happening now. I decree that the waiting season is over. I decree that this is your season of manifestation. I decree that things that have been on hold are being released. I decree that doors that have been locked are being opened. I decree that opportunities that have been delayed are being accelerated. I decree that you are moving from [music] promise to performance, from prophecy to fulfillment, from declaration to manifestation. Let me pray a militant prayer right now. Father, in the name that is above every name, the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, I come against every arrow of stress and pressure that has been released against the lives of your children. I decree that those arrows have broken right now. I decree that every weapon fashioned against them is destroyed. I decree that every plot of the enemy is exposed and dismantled. I decree that every scheme of hell is aborted. I decree that every plan of darkness is paralyzed. I speak to the spirit of financial stress and I command you to lose your hold right now in Jesus name. I speak to the spirit of relational stress and I command you to release God's people. I speak to the spirit of health related stress and I command you to depart [music] now. I speak to the spirit of mental and emotional stress and I command you to be cast out. I speak to the spirit of occupational stress and I decree that divine favor is taken over. I speak to the spirit of family stress and I decree that peace is being restored. Every arrow of stress that was released at night be broken now. Every arrow of stress that was released during prayer be destroyed now. Every arrow of stress that was released through witchcraft be consumed by the fire of God. Every arrow of stress that was released through evil altars be nullified by the blood of Jesus. Every arrow of stress that was released through evil dreams be shattered into pieces. I decree that no weapon formed against you [music] shall prosper and every tongue that rises against you in judgment you shall condemn. Father, I ask that you release your ministering angels right now to go into the realm of the spirit and to gather every arrow of stress that was scheduled to be released against your children in the next 24 hours, in the next one week, in the next one month, in the next one year. Let those angels intercept those arrows and cast them into the abyss. I decree that the enemy's ammunition is depleted. I decree that the enemy's strategy is frustrated. I decree that the enemy's [music] timing is disrupted. I decree that the children of God are walking under an open heaven of protection, provision, and peace. I decree Psalm 91 over your life right now. He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the almighty. I will say of the Lord, he is my refuge and my fortress, my God. In him will I trust. Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence. He shall cover thee with his [music] feathers, and under his wings shall thou trust. His truth shall be thy shield and buckler. Thou shalt not be afraid for [music] the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flyth by day, nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday. A thousand shall fall at thy side, and 10,000 at thy right hand, but it shall not come nigh thee. I decree that stress will not come near you. Pressure will not dominate you. Anxiety will not control you. Fear will not paralyze you. Worry will not consume you. You are covered by the blood of Jesus. You are hidden in the secret place of the most high. You are protected by the power of God. You are guarded by the angels of the Lord. You are walking in divine immunity. You are operating in supernatural authority. You are living in the victory [music] that Jesus purchased for you on the cross. Now receive your deliverance. Receive your breakthrough. Receive your peace. Receive your rest. The Lord is giving you [music] beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness. You are not a victim, you are a victor. You are not defeated. You are delivered. You are not stressed. You are blessed. You are not under pressure. You are under the presence of God. It is done. It is finished. It is settled in heaven and manifested on earth. In the mighty, powerful, matchless name of Jesus Christ, I have prayed. Amen.
